name: blort
description: Analyze any video or link, find what's going viral, break down creators, and write scripts from your research

interface.longDescription: Blort analyzes any video, post, website or PDF, finds what's going viral on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, breaks down creators, and writes scripts grounded in your research. Research can be saved to a Blort board to come back to and chat with.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this reel and tell me why it worked.
What's going viral in fitness on TikTok this month?
Write me a 30-second script about meal prep.

positive.prompt: Analyze this video and tell me why it worked: https://www.tiktok.com/@saraisnuts/video/7696265174440742166
positive.expected_behavior: Processes the video with Blort without putting it on a board and breaks down its hook (with a reusable formula), format, structure with transcript excerpts, visual layout and takeaways, using the video's real transcript and metrics.

positive.prompt: What's going viral in fitness right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists 3-5 patterns behind top fitness videos from Blort's viral library, ranked by outlier score where available, each with a hook formula and 2-3 example videos with creator, link and metrics. Reads already analyzed hits with get_sources and adds nothing to a board.

positive.prompt: Break down what @nocodealex posts on Instagram and what performs best.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the creator, reads their profile stats and top posts, analyzes the best ones without putting them on a board, and summarizes their audience, formats, hook types, best performers and what to borrow. Offers to save the videos to a board at the end.

positive.prompt: Write a 30-second TikTok script about meal prep for busy parents.
positive.expected_behavior: Grounds the script in example videos from Blort's viral library and returns three hooks, a beat-by-beat script with visual directions, why it should work, and a caption.

positive.prompt: What boards do I have in Blort?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's recent Blort boards with their names and links.

negative.prompt: Post this video to my TikTok account.

negative.description: Billing and plan changes are not supported

negative.prompt: What's the weather in New York today?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: analyze videos, posts and links; viral research; creator breakdowns; script writing; Blort boards.
